review.note: Wikidata's P361 on Q380067 names the Thirty Years' War and that is where this record is filed; the English article's own first sentence calls the battle one of the Polish-Swedish War of 1626-1629, which this atlas does not yet hold. Both are stated by the sources cited and neither was chosen over the other by anybody here — a reviewer decides.

title: Battle of Trzciana
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Trzciana", at revision 1370591664, opens: "The Battle of Trzciana took place on 25 June 1629 and was one of the battles of the Polish-Swedish War (1626–1629) or Second Swedish-Polish War. The Polish forces, including the winged hussars, were led by Crown Field Hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and imperial troops under Hans Georg von Arnim-Boitzenburg, sent by Emperor Ferdinand II to aid Sigismund III, met with troops commanded by Swedish King Gustav II Adolf, who supported the Protestant Lutherans of Germany and northern Europe. Gustav Adolf was almost killed or captured twice. Fighting in Prussia continued after the battle into July and August and ended with stalemate and finally a truce accepted by Sigismund III." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q380067, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1629 battle of the Polish-Swedish wars". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
